entities.name: Barrow
entities.description: A young human bonder of Ikoria with long white hair and a horned metal circlet, who is bonded to the monster Zeph and speaks for him.

entities.name: Zeph
entities.description: A massive white, tiger-striped cat-clade monster that controls electricity and is bonded to Barrow.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: The plane where humans bond with monsters and where Barrow and Zeph live.

entities.name: The Ozolith
entities.description: A powerful crystalline structure that influences monster behavior and began exerting a dangerous compulsion on monsters across Ikoria.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A bonder transformed by the Ozolith who gains control over monsters and uses them to attack Drannith.

entities.name: Leori
entities.description: The winged cat bonded to Lukka, about half the size of Zeph.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker and hunter who gathers the bonders against the Ozolith's corruption and later helps defend Drannith.

entities.name: Abda
entities.description: A bonder who greets Barrow and Zeph and rides with them to the Ozolith.

entities.name: Brin
entities.description: A bonder who requested the gathering and later relays messages in Drannith.

entities.name: Jirina Kudro
entities.description: A crew member of the skyship Vermilion who takes de facto command of Drannith's defense.

entities.name: Vermilion
entities.description: A skyship that joins the fight at the Ozolith and is dragged down by the great snake.

entities.name: Roland
entities.description: A monster present at the Ozolith that shakes off its command, and who later stands with Jirina.

entities.name: Colonel Bryd
entities.description: A Drannith officer at the inner gate whom Jirina confronts.

entities.name: Major Humron
entities.description: An officer who joins the war room planning in Drannith.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: The walled city of Ikoria, defended by its Citadel and rings, that Lukka attacks.

entities.name: Battle at the Ozolith
entities.description: The clash between bonders, hunters and nightmare monsters at the Ozolith.

entities.name: Siege of Drannith
entities.description: Lukka's monster army assault on Drannith.

entities.name: Coppercoats
entities.description: The Drannith military force whose position at the Ozolith collapsed.

events.summary: Barrow and Zeph join a gathering of bonders and allies in the wilds, greeted by Abda, Vivien Reid and Lukka.
events.quote: Zeph was immediately recognized as a formidable monster, and his presence drew attention for both his size and power.

events.summary: After hearing Lukka and Vivien, Barrow becomes convinced action is needed about the Ozolith, and the pair agree to help reach it.
events.quote: Barrow and Zeph agreed to assist in the effort to reach the Ozolith and determine the source of its corruption.

events.summary: Barrow first spots the serpentine nightmares among the Ozolith's crystals and asks the group to be set down.
events.quote: it was Barrow who first spotted the serpentine nightmares coiled among the crystals and asked for the group to be set down

events.summary: In the Battle at the Ozolith, Zeph attacks the largest nightmare while Barrow channels lightning through their bond and blasts its head.
events.quote: unleashing a surge of arcing lightning that tore into the nightmare's head

events.summary: The Ozolith pulses and the nightmares turn on the hunters; the great snake drags the skyship Vermilion down while Barrow and Zeph survive.
events.quote: The great snake coiled around Vermilion, dragging it down despite the crew's frantic attempts to flee.

events.summary: Lukka returns transformed and announces he controls the monsters; Barrow opposes him, saying Zeph is his partner, not a subordinate.
events.quote: Lukka announced that he had gained control over the monsters and intended to use this power to support Drannith.

events.summary: Lukka tries to control Zeph through the Ozolith but fails; Barrow and Zeph flee when Vivien orders the bonders to escape.
events.quote: Zeph remained with Barrow as they fled the scene, refusing to submit to Lukka's will

events.summary: Barrow and Zeph travel with Jirina and Vivien back to Drannith by indirect routes, avoiding Lukka's monsters.
events.quote: They kept to indirect routes to avoid Lukka's monsters and the city's civilian population

events.summary: Jirina confronts Colonel Bryd, assumes command, and the gates open so Zeph and Barrow enter Drannith.
events.quote: After Jirina assumed command, the gates were opened, and Zeph entered the city without incident

events.summary: In the Citadel war room Barrow, Vivien, Brin and Major Humron join Jirina to plan against Lukka's attack.
events.quote: In the Citadel's war room, Barrow, Vivien, Brin, and Major Humron joined her around a map of Drannith to prepare for Lukka's imminent attack.

events.summary: Barrow agrees the secondary wall cannot be held, calls other bonders, and several arrive by dawn.
events.quote: By dawn, Barrow's call had been answered: several bonders and monsters arrived in the city

events.summary: Lukka's army comes into view as the Siege of Drannith begins; Barrow and Zeph are held in reserve near the north gate.
events.quote: As the sun rose, Lukka's massive army came into view

events.summary: Monsters breach the inner city; Barrow and Zeph defeat several intruders before being overwhelmed.
events.quote: The pair intercepted and defeated several intruders but were soon overwhelmed by the scale of the incursion.

events.summary: Barrow and Zeph lead the bonded charge through the main gate to rescue Jirina, turning the tide until Lukka is surrounded.
events.quote: Barrow and Zeph were the first to break through the main gate, leading the charge of bonded fighters to rescue her.

events.summary: After the siege, Jirina lets bonders and monsters live in the First Ring and Barrow and Zeph help normalize monsters among people.
events.quote: Jirina authorized bonders and their monsters to reside in the First Ring, just outside the city proper.

relations.quote: Barrow and Zeph are a bonded human-monster pair native to the plane of Ikoria
Barrow immediately opposed the idea, clarifying that Zeph was his partner, not a subordinate

relations.note: Leori is the winged cat bonded to Lukka
relations.quote: the winged cat bonded to Lukka

relations.note: accompanies and supports her in defending Drannith
relations.quote: Barrow and Zeph accompanied Jirina Kudro and Vivien Reid on the return journey to Drannith
